vocabulary.meaning: contact — the meeting of sense, object and consciousness. The six of them close on this sheet, having opened with the eye and the ear on page 146

vocabulary.pali: สัมผัสสะชา เวทะนา
vocabulary.meaning: feeling BORN OF contact. -ชา is 'born from', so the phrase names feeling by its cause rather than by its flavour — which is why the survey lists contact first and feeling immediately after
perception: the recognising of a thing as the thing it is. The third of the five aggregates, and the set this sheet opens

vocabulary.meaning: of a dear form, of an agreeable form. The tail this whole survey repeats — what makes a thing a place craving can lodge is not what it is but that it is liked
